description: This file implements a status reporting loop for a car engine controller firmware, including sensor data collection, logging, and status display routines. It provides functions for periodic status updates, sensor data reporting, and communication with external tools like TunerStudio, as well as initialization and threading for status indicators and LCD display.

classes.name: Logging
classes.description: A logging utility class used for capturing and managing log messages, initialized with a label and buffer.

classes.name: LoggingWithStorage
classes.description: A specialized logging class with storage capabilities, used for main event handling.

methods.name: printOverallStatus
methods.description: Periodically reports overall engine and system status, including version info and hardware pin states.

methods.name: updateDevConsoleState
methods.description: Sends all pending data and status reports to the connected development console, including sensor data and errors.

methods.name: showFuelInfo2
methods.description: Calculates and displays fuel-related parameters based on RPM and engine load.

methods.name: showFuelInfo
methods.description: Wrapper that calls showFuelInfo2 with current RPM and engine load for display.

methods.name: initStatusLoop
methods.description: Initializes status logging and control commands for the firmware, adding console actions.

methods.name: startStatusThreads
methods.description: Starts background threads for LCD display and status LED blinking.

methods.name: setFullLog
methods.description: Enables or disables full logging mode.

methods.name: getFullLog
methods.description: Returns whether full logging is enabled.
